item.title: President Lee: “Tens of Trillions in Unused Card Points to Be Considered for Conversion to Local Currency” (이 대통령 “수십조 미사용 카드포인트, 지역화폐로 전환 검토”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 30th, “When you make card payments, shop, or sign up for memberships, there are points that get accumulated, but a lot of them go unused. I think it would be good to push forward a plan to convert various points into local currency.” (이재명 대통령이 30일 “카드 결제, 쇼핑, 멤버십 가입을 하면 소위 적립되는 포인트가 있는데, 사용되지 않고 있는 게 많다. 각종 포인트를 지역화폐로 전환하는 방안을 추진하면 좋겠다”고 말했다.)

At a Cabinet meeting and the 13th Emergency Economic Review Meeting held at the Blue House that day, President Lee stated, “It is said that there are tens of trillions of won worth of hidden points (from cards, memberships, etc.) that people either didn’t know about or couldn’t use due to circumstances,” and instructed, “I ask the relevant ministries to actively review plans for how to utilize these idle, hidden points.” ( 이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 열린 국무회의 겸 제13차 비상경제점검회의에서 “몰랐거나 쓸 수 없는 사정으로 숨어 있는 (카드·멤버십 등) 포인트가 수십조원에 이른다고 한다”며 “관련 부처에서 쉬고 있는, 숨어 있는 포인트를 어떻게 활용할지 적극적으로 방안을 검토해주시기 바란다”고 지시했다.)

President Lee remarked, “It may seem like a trivial issue, but it’s not an easy task either,” emphasizing the need to boost the use of local currency to enhance consumption vitality. Local currency is one of the signature policies that Lee has promoted since his time as mayor of Seongnam City. ( 이 대통령은 “소소한 문제라고 보이기는 하는데, 이것도 쉬운 일은 아니다”라면서 소비 활력 제고를 위해 지역화폐 활용도를 높여야 한다고 했다. 지역화폐는 이 대통령이 성남시장 시절부터 추진해온 대표 정책 중 하나다.)

President Lee said, “Another foundation for creating sustainable growth engines is actual consumption capacity, or enhancing consumption vitality,” adding, “In the first quarter of this year, private consumption showed signs of recovery, but to accelerate this further, we need additional diverse measures to stimulate consumption.” He continued, “Efforts to increase the use of local currency, which is particularly effective in revitalizing traditional markets and neighborhood commercial districts, are essential,” and noted, “I mention this because there are available resources (in the form of points).” ( 이 대통령은 “지속가능한 성장 동력 창출의 또 다른 기반은 실질적인 소비 능력, 또는 소비 활력 제고”라며 “지난 1분기엔 민간 소비가 회복 흐름을 보이기는 했는데, 이를 더욱 가속화하기 위해서는 다양한 소비 진작 대책이 추가로 더 있어야 한다”고 했다. 이어 “특히 전통시장과 골목상권 경기 활성화에 효과가 큰 지역화폐 활용도를 높이는 노력이 꼭 필요하다”며 “(포인트라는) 가용자원이 있어서 말씀드리는 것”이라고 했다.)

By Seo Young-ji, Reporter yj@hani.co.kr, and Go Kyung-ju, Reporter goh@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr 고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "Prime Minister Kim Min-seok Contributed the Most... Shall We Give Him a Round of Applause?" President Lee's Public Encouragement (“김민석 공 가장 컸다…박수 한 번 드릴까” 이 대통령의 공개 격려)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 30th, "Barring any special circumstances, it seems the prime minister will be replaced soon," adding, "Our government has achieved many results, and I believe Prime Minister Kim Min-seok played the biggest role." (이재명 대통령이 30일 “조만간 특별한 사정이 없으면 총리가 교체될 거 같다”며 “우리 정부가 만들어낸 여러 성과가 있는데 김민석 국무총리의 역할이 가장 컸다고 생각한다”고 말했다.)

During a cabinet meeting chaired at the Blue House that day, President Lee stated, "Shall we give the hardworking Prime Minister Kim a round of applause?" The attending cabinet members applauded. Regarding Prime Minister Kim, President Lee said, "What I want to praise the most is the reduction in suicides. Looking at the statistics from early this year, the number of suicides has decreased by hundreds each month. Saving hundreds of lives is very significant." <<> In response, Prime Minister Kim said, "The public might not believe this, but we haven't had a single cabinet dinner gathering in the past year. I've been that busy. I will also give my all and work even harder with the party and the National Assembly." <<> Prime Minister Kim has effectively announced his candidacy for the upcoming Democratic Party of Korea convention in August and has expressed his intention to resign. If the Democratic Party of Korea fails to reach an agreement with the People Power Party by this morning on adopting the progress report of the confirmation hearing for Prime Minister nominee Han Seong-sook, the Democratic Party and non-negotiating groups are considering adopting the progress report on their own and putting the confirmation motion to a vote at the plenary session. <<> Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr Reporter Go Kyung-joo goh@hani.co.kr (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의에서 “고생한 김 총리에게 박수 한 번 드릴까”라며 이렇게 말했다. 참석한 국무위원들은 박수를 쳤다. 이 대통령은 김 총리에 대해 “제일 높이 평가하고 싶은 건 자살자 감소”라며 “올 연초 통계부터 보면 월간 수백명 단위로 자살자가 줄었다. 수백명의 목숨을 구한 건 매우 의미가 있다”고 말했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Public officials have sacrificed too harshly… Let's completely lift the 'vehicle two-day restriction'" (이 대통령 “공직자들 너무 가혹하게 희생…‘차량 2부제’ 다 풀어주자”)
item.description:
On the 30th, President Lee Jae-myung ordered that the vehicle two-day restriction in the public sector be lifted all at once, rather than phased out. <<> During a cabinet meeting presided over at the Presidential Office that day, President Lee made this remark after Vice Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy Moon Shin-hak reported, "With concerns over crude oil supply shortages easing following the start of negotiations to end the Middle East war, we plan to ease the vehicle two-day restriction to a five-day restriction." <<> President Lee said, "You're talking about moving from a vehicle two-day restriction to a five-day restriction. Don't you think public officials have been forced to sacrifice too harshly?" He added, "(The vehicle two-day restriction) is a preemptive measure taken by public officials to set an example during a crisis, but does the lifting process have to be gradual? Wouldn't it be fine to just lift it all now?" <<> Vice Minister Moon responded, "Considering the impact on fuel consumption, even a five-day restriction wouldn't pose a big problem. We just couldn't bring ourselves to suggest abolishing it entirely." <<> In response, President Lee said, "If it's ineffective, let's just lift it all. Regulations should be limited to cases where they are truly necessary." <<> Reporters: Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr Ko Kyung-joo goh@hani.co.kr (이재명 대통령이 30일 공공부문 차량 2부제를 단계적으로 해제하지 말고 한 번에 해제하라고 지시했다.)

item.title: National Assembly Adopts Confirmation Report on PM Nominee Han Seong-sook... People Power Party Absent (국회, 한성숙 총리 후보 인사청문보고서 채택…국힘 불참)
item.description:
The National Assembly's Special Committee on Personnel Confirmation adopted the review report on Prime Minister nominee Han Seong-sook on the 30th, led by the Democratic Party of Korea. The Democratic Party plans to put the motion to approve the nominee to a vote at the plenary session scheduled for the afternoon of the same day. (국회 인사청문특별위원회가 30일 한성숙 국무총리 후보자에 대한 인사청문 심사경과보고서를 더불어민주당 주도로 채택했다. 민주당은 이날 오후 열리는 국회 본회의에서 한 후보자 임명동의안을 표결에 부칠 예정이다.)

The National Assembly's 'Special Committee on Personnel Confirmation Regarding the Motion to Approve the Appointment of Prime Minister Han Seong-sook' held a full committee meeting on that day to adopt the review report on the nominee's appointment motion. The report included 'qualified' as the majority opinion. Members from the People Power Party did not attend the special committee meeting, protesting the agenda item's submission on the grounds that 'negotiations on forming standing committees for the second half of the 22nd National Assembly should take precedence.' (국회 ‘한성숙 국무총리 임명 동의에 관한 인사청문특별위원회’는 이날 전체회의를 열어 한 후보자 임명동의안 심사경과보고서를 채택했다. 보고서에는 ‘적격’이 다수 의견으로 담겼다. 국민의힘 소속 위원들은 ‘22대 국회 후반기 상임위원회 구성 협상이 우선’이라는 이유로 안건 상정에 반발하며 특위 회의에 들어오지 않았다.)

The Democratic Party plans to report the review results to the National Assembly's plenary session in the afternoon and immediately hold a vote on the appointment motion for nominee Han. The Prime Minister can be appointed only if the confirmation motion passes the plenary session with a majority of registered members present and a majority of those present voting in favor. Since the Democratic Party already has more than half of the 300 registered members, with 161 seats, it can proceed with the vote and processing without the consent of the People Power Party. (민주당은 이날 오후 열리는 국회 본회의에 심사경과보고서를 보고하고, 곧바로 한 후보자 임명동의안을 표결할 예정이다. 국무총리는 국회 본회의에서 재적의원 과반 출석 및 출석의원 과반 찬성으로 인준안이 통과돼야 임명될 수 있다. 민주당 의원 수가 이미 재적의원(300명) 과반인 161명인 만큼, 국민의힘의 동의 없이도 표결과 처리가 가능하다.)

Reporters: Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr, Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr (김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr 조희연 기자 choh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Yoon Geon-young, a Pro-Moon Figure: "Yoo Si-min Even Declined the PM Post... We Should Listen Carefully to What He Says" (‘친문’ 윤건영 “유시민 총리직도 고사…그분 말 잘 들어야”)
item.description:
Yoon Geon-young, a lawmaker from the Democratic Party of Korea, commented on the controversy surrounding author Yoo Si-min’s "redevelopment theory" within the ruling camp, saying, "Yoo is someone who even declined the position of Prime Minister," and added, "The most important thing is to listen carefully to what he says." (윤건영 더불어민주당 의원은 유시민 작가의 ‘재건축론’이 여권에서 논란이 된 것과 관련해 “유 작가는 국무총리도 고사했던 인물”이라며 “그분이 한 말을 잘 듣는 게 제일 중요하다”고 말했다.)

In an interview with CBS Radio’s "Park Jae-hong’s One-Shot Match" on the 29th, Yoon, a pro-Moon figure, stated, "He has a life story he’s lived through, and I think the first and foremost priority is to listen closely to what he says." (‘친문’인 윤 의원은 29일 시비에스(CBS) 라디오 ‘박재홍의 한판승부’와의 인터뷰에서 “(유 작가가) 이때까지 살아온 서사가 있는데 그분이 한 말에 대해서 잘 듣는 게 우선 첫 번째로 제일 중요한 것 같다”고 했다.)

Regarding Yoo’s analogy of "redevelopment," Yoon assessed it by saying, "Truly, ‘that’s Yoo Si-min.’ He makes such sharp analogies. Things like redevelopment or extension." When the host noted that "more people seem to think the remarks were harsh," Yoon responded, "It’s rough, so it scratches (the listener’s ear)." He continued, "That’s why people might talk about the analogy without seeing the essence. There are cases where you should look at the moon but end up looking at the finger. Still, I hope people keep their ears open." Yoon added, "Aren’t (Yoo’s remarks) a warning about the current situation? It seems he judged that if things continue like this, the success of a Lee Jae-myung government would be difficult, and many issues would get tangled up." (윤 의원은 유 작가의 ‘재건축’ 비유에 대해 “정말 ‘역시 유시민이다’. 비유를 너무 찰지게 한다. 재건축, 증축 이런 부분들”이라고 평가했다. 윤 의원은 ‘발언이 거칠다고 본 이들이 더 많은 거 같다’는 진행자의 말에 “거치니까 (듣는 쪽에서) 긁힌 것이다”라고 답했다. 이어 “그렇기 때문에 본질을 보지 않고 그 비유를 보고 이야기할 수도 있다. 달을 봐야 되는데 손가락을 보는 경우도 있을 것”이라며 “그런데 귀는 열었으면 좋겠다”고 했다. 윤 의원은 “(유 작가 발언은) 지금 상황에 대한 경고 아니겠냐”며 “이대로 가다가는 이재명 정부의 성공도 어렵고 여러 가지로 많은 문제들이 꼬이겠다고 판단한 것 같다”고 덧붙였다.)

Regarding the previous day’s criticism from Democratic Party lawmaker Ko Min-jung, who called out Yoo by saying, "Is it not okay to use ‘Moon-confucius-plucking Yoo,’ but it’s fine to say ‘traitor’ or ‘watermelon’?" Yoon commented, "Lawmaker Ko sees things from her position, and Yoo sees things from his position, so such differences of opinion arise." (전날 고민정 민주당 의원이 유 작가를 향해 “‘문조털래유’는 쓰면 안 되고 ‘매국노’, ‘수박’ 이런 건 해도 되는 거냐”고 비판한 데 대해 윤 의원은 “고 의원은 고 의원이 서 있는 위치에서, 유 작가는 유 작가가 서 있는 위치에서 바라보기 때문에 그런 이견이 있는 것”이라고 했다.)

On Yoo referring to some critics as "juvenile law critics," Yoon said, "The analogy is truly sharp." He repeatedly emphasized, "Even if the analogy is somewhat disagreeable, I hope people look at the essence of what the speaker is trying to say and discuss it." (윤 의원은 유 작가가 일부 평론가를 향해 “촉법 평론가”라고 지칭한 데 대해서도 “진짜 비유가 찰지더라”라고 했다. 이어 “비유가 다소 마음에 안 들더라도 상대가 말하려고 하는, 화자의 본질이 뭐냐를 보고 토론했으면 좋겠다”고 거듭 강조했다.)

Reporter Song Kyung-hwa freehwa@hani.co.kr (송경화 기자 freehwa@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Immediately After "This is Han Dong-hoon," Jang Dong-hyuk Leaves Telegram Group (“한동훈입니다” 직후, 장동혁 텔레방 ‘바로 퇴장’)
item.description:
Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon was invited to the Telegram group chat of the "National Assembly Global Diplomatic Security Forum," led by Yoon Jae-ok of the People Power Party (PPP), and PPP leader Jang Dong-hyuk immediately exited the group chat. (한동훈 무소속 의원이 윤재옥 국민의힘 의원이 주도하는 ‘국회 글로벌 외교안보포럼’ 텔레그램 단체방에 초대되자, 장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 단체방에서 곧바로 나간 것으로 나타났다.)

According to a PPP official on the 30th, Han was invited to the Global Diplomatic Security Forum Telegram group chat that morning. This followed his assignment to the Foreign Affairs and Unification Committee in the latter half of the National Assembly. The Global Diplomatic Security Forum is a research group of lawmakers involving both ruling and opposition party members. It includes not only PPP lawmakers but also Kim Young-bae of the Democratic Party of Korea and Lee Joo-young of the Reform Party. (30일 국민의힘 관계자의 말을 들어보면, 한 의원은 이날 오전 글로벌 외교안보포럼 텔레그램 단체방에 초대됐다. 후반기 국회에서 외교통일위원회에 배정된 데 따른 것이다. 글로벌 외교안보포럼은 여야 의원들이 참여하는 국회의원 연구단체이다. 국민의힘 의원들뿐만 아니라 김영배 더불어민주당 의원, 이주영 개혁신당 의원 등도 참여하고 있다. )

Upon entering the group chat, Han left a message saying, "Thank you for the invitation! This is Han Dong-hoon." In response, PPP leader Jang Dong-hyuk immediately left the Telegram room without leaving any other message. (단체방에 입장한 한 의원이 ‘초대해주셔서 감사드립니다! 한동훈입니다’라는 메시지를 남겼다. 그러자 장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 별다른 메시지를 남기지 않고 곧바로 텔레그램방에서 나갔다.)

Han and Jang have been in conflict within the party, and the PPP expelled Han in January over the so-called "party member bulletin board" controversy. (한 의원과 장 대표는 당내 갈등을 이어왔고, 국민의힘은 지난 1월 ‘당원 게시판’ 논란을 이유로 한 의원을 제명했다.)

Jang appeared on the YouTube channel Pen and Mike on the 26th and said, targeting Han, "The person who caused the conservative party to end up in this state claims to rebuild conservatism and, joining forces with others, attacks the party leader and says they will kick him out. Correcting such matters first is the way to establish party discipline and is the first step toward reforming the party and rebuilding conservatism." (장 대표는 지난 26일 펜앤마이크 유튜브에 출연해 한 의원을 겨냥해 “보수 정당이 이 지경에 오도록 원인을 제공했던 사람이 보수 재건을 하고, 그와 힘을 합쳐 당대표를 공격하고 내쫓겠다고 한다”며 “그런 것부터 바로잡는 것이 당 기강을 확립하는 것이고 당을 쇄신하는 보수 재건의 첫걸음”이라고 말했다.)

Reporter Kim Hae-jung sea@hani.co.kr (김해정 기자 sea@hani.co.kr)

item.title: People Power Party Reviews Parliamentary Probe into ‘Honam Semiconductor Investment’… “Chairmen as Mere Props Left and Right, Crony Capitalism” (국힘, ‘호남 반도체 투자’ 국정조사 검토…“회장 좌우로 들러리, 관치 경제”)
item.description:
The People Power Party (PPP) stated on the 30th that the government’s announcement of semiconductor factory investments in the Honam region by Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix was “rushed and unsystematic,” adding that “we have no choice but to seriously consider a parliamentary investigation.” (국민의힘이 정부와 삼성전자·에스케이(SK)하이닉스의 호남권 반도체 공장 투자 발표가 졸속으로 추진됐다며 “국정조사를 진지하게 검토할 수밖에 없다”고 30일 밝혔다.)

PPP floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik said at a party strategy meeting this morning, “The president, flanked by major corporate chairmen as mere props left and right, making grandiose claims about astronomical-scale investments—that is the very symbol of crony capitalism.” The PPP has repeatedly raised concerns that large-scale semiconductor investments should be decided by companies, and that the government-led announcement was particularly timed ahead of the Democratic Party of Korea’s national convention. (정점식 국민의힘 원내대표는 이날 오전 국회 원내대책회의에서 “대통령이 대기업 회장들을 좌우로 들러리 세운 채 천문학적 규모의 투자를 운운하는 그 모습이야말로 관치 경제의 상징”이라며 이렇게 말했다. 국민의힘은 대규모 반도체 투자는 기업이 결정할 일이며, 특히 정부가 주도한 발표가 더불어민주당 전당대회를 앞두고 이뤄진 점을 연일 문제 삼고 있다.)

Floor leader Jeong added, “The PPP does not oppose investment in Honam. What we are insisting on is that the fairness and transparency of the procedures for such astronomical investments be properly upheld.” He continued, “Rushing forward unprepared like this does not benefit Honam or the entire Republic of Korea.” Jeong also remarked, “A parliamentary investigation was conducted over a 10,000-won salmon rice bowl, so there is no reason not to investigate 800 trillion won worth of semiconductor investments.” This refers to the so-called “salmon drinking party” allegations raised by Lee Hwa-young, former deputy governor of Gyeonggi Province, in connection with the Ssangbangwool remittance to North Korea case, which was addressed by the National Assembly’s special committee on the “fabricated indictment.” (정 원내대표는 “국민의힘은 호남에 대한 투자를 반대하지 않는다. 천문학적 투자에 관한 절차의 공정성과 투명성을 제대로 지키라는 것”이라며 “지금처럼 준비되지 않은 졸속 추진은 호남에도 대한민국 전체에도 이익이 되지 않는다”고 말했다. 정 원내대표는 이어 “만원짜리 연어 덮밥도 국정조사를 했는데 800조원 규모의 반도체 투자를 (국정조사) 못할 이유가 없다”고 했다. 쌍방울 대북송금 사건과 관련해 이화영 전 경기도 평화부지사가 제기한 이른바 ‘연어 술 파티’ 의혹이 국회 ‘조작기소 국정조사특위’에서 다뤄진 점을 언급한 것이다.)

Twenty-five PPP lawmakers from Busan, Ulsan, and South Gyeongsang also held a press conference at the National Assembly on the same day, protesting, “Semiconductors are not a factory built by calculating voter sentiment.” They demanded, “This method of announcing first and scrambling to provide justification later is not industrial policy but political scheming and populism. Disclose to the public why it’s Honam and how it compares with other regions, including Busan, Ulsan, and South Gyeongsang.” (부산·울산·경남 지역 국민의힘 의원 25명도 이날 국회에서 기자회견을 열어 “반도체는 표심으로 짓는 공장이 아니다”고 반발했다. 이들은 “발표부터 해놓고 뒤늦게 근거를 맞추는 방식은 산업정책이 아니라 정치적 기획이고 ‘표퓰리즘’”이라며 “왜 호남인지, 부·울·경(부산·울산·경남)을 비롯한 다른 지역과 어떻게 비교했는지 국민 앞에 밝혀라”고 요구했다.)

Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (유영재 기자 young@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Tomorrow's Second Agency Report for 'National Assembly Audit on Election Commission'... Yoon Ho-jung and Noh Tae-ak to Appear as Witnesses (내일 ‘선관위 국정조사’ 2차 기관보고…윤호중·노태악 증인 출석)
item.description:
Yoon Ho-jung, Minister of the Interior and Safety, Noh Tae-ak, former Chair of the National Election Commission (NEC), and all eight current NEC commissioners will attend the second agency report of the National Assembly's audit on the election commission, scheduled for the 1st. (오는 1일 열리는 국회 ‘선관위 국정조사’ 2차 기관보고에 윤호중 행정안전부 장관과 노태악 전 중앙선거관리위원장, 현직 중앙선거관리위원 8명이 모두 출석한다.)

According to an official from the National Assembly's Special Committee on the Audit to Investigate the Truth of the Violation of Citizens' Right to Vote, Including the Ballot Shortage Crisis in the 9th Nationwide Local Elections, and to Reform Election Management (Special Audit Committee) on the 30th, all eight current NEC commissioners, including former Chair Noh and Acting NEC Chair Wi Cheol-hwan, who were selected as witnesses for the second agency report, have confirmed their attendance. Heo Cheol-hoon, former Secretary-General of the NEC, has also indicated his attendance. In total, the Special Audit Committee has requested the appearance of 30 NEC officials, including these individuals. (30일 국회 ‘제9회 전국동시지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태 등 국민 참정권 침해 진상 규명 및 선거 관리 개혁을 위한 국정조사 특별위원회’(국조특위) 관계자에 따르면, 2차 기관보고 증인으로 채택된 노 전 위원장과 위철환 중앙선관위원장 직무대행 등 현직 중앙선관위원 8명이 모두 출석 뜻을 밝혔다. 허철훈 전 중앙선관위 사무총장도 출석 뜻을 밝혔다. 국조특위가 출석을 요구한 중앙선관위 관계자는 이들을 포함해 모두 30명이다.)

Twenty officials from the Seoul City and Songpa District Election Commissions, where the ballot shortage was most prevalent, have also been included on the witness list. This includes eight officials from the Seoul City Election Commission, such as former Chair Oh Min-seok, and 12 officials from the Songpa District Election Commission, including former Chair Min So-young. Additionally, three officials from the Ministry of the Interior and Safety, including Minister Yoon, and three officials from the National Police Agency, including Acting Commissioner General Yoo Jae-seong, have been added to the witness list. (투표용지 부족 사태가 가장 많이 일어난 서울시·송파구 선관위 관계자 20명도 증인 명단에 포함됐다. 오민석 전 서울시선관위원장 등 서울시선관위 관계자 8명, 민소영 전 송파구선관위원장 등 송파구선관위 관계자 12명 등이다. 윤 장관 등 행안부 관계자 3명, 유재성 경찰청장 직무대행 등 경찰청 관계자 3명도 증인 명단에 포함됐다.)

Ruling party secretary of the Special Audit Committee, Representative Yoon Geon-young of the Democratic Party of Korea, met with reporters after a morning meeting of the committee's ruling and opposition party secretaries and stated, "Jo Hyun-wook, Chair of the NEC's Truth Investigation Committee, said he had other commitments during the day and would attend at night, so we informed him that is unacceptable." (국조특위 여당 간사인 윤건영 더불어민주당 의원은 이날 오전 국조특위 여야 간사 회동을 마친 뒤 취재진을 만나 “조현욱 중앙선관위 진상규명위원장이 낮에 용무가 있어 밤에 출석한다고 해 ‘그건 수용할 수 없다’고 통보했다”고 밝혔다.)

The Special Audit Committee plans to conduct on-site investigations on the 2nd of next month at the Jamsil Olympic Park in Songpa-gu, Seoul, and the Songpa District Election Commission, and on the 7th at the NEC and the Seoul City Election Commission. Representative Yoon said, "We plan to go inside the Olympic Park counting station, but we'll have to assess the situation on-site. The agreement between the ruling and opposition parties is to go as far as we can without causing friction, by persuading those individuals (participants in the counting station blockade protests)." He added to the protest participants, "Since the ruling and opposition parties have come together for this on-site investigation, if you cooperate, we can get a bit closer to uncovering the truth." (국조특위는 내달 2일 서울 송파구 잠실 올림픽공원과 송파구선관위를, 7일에는 중앙선관위와 서울시선관위를 찾아 현장조사를 할 예정이다. 윤 의원은 “(올림픽공원 개표소 안까지) 들어가는 것으로 계획하는데, 현장 상황을 봐야 할 것 같다. 여야가 협의한 건 마찰을 일으키지 않고 그분들(개표소 봉쇄 시위 참가자들)을 설득해 가볼 수 있는 데까지 가는 것”이라며 올림픽공원 개표소 봉쇄 시위 참가자들에게 “여야가 뜻을 모아 현장조사를 하는 것이니 협조해주시면 진상 규명에 조금 더 다가갈 수 있을 것 같다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee on 896 Trillion Won Investment in Honam: "A Reward for Upholding Democracy… We Will Surely Succeed" (이 대통령, 호남 896조 투자에 “민주주의 지켜온 보상…반드시 성공”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 30th regarding the large-scale semiconductor investment in the southwestern region, "I view this as a historic and national reward for Honam, which endured the pain and humiliation of discrimination without any compensation or reward, building and protecting South Korea’s democracy. I will ensure it succeeds without a hitch." (이재명 대통령이 30일 서남권의 대규모 반도체 투자와 관련해 “아무런 보상과 대가 없이도 차별의 고통과 설움을 견뎌내며 대한민국의 민주주의를 만들고 지켜온 호남에 대한 역사적·국민적 보상으로 생각하고 일체의 차질 없이 반드시 성공시키겠다”고 말했다.)

Through a written congratulatory message at the 'National Report Meeting on the Vision for Advanced Industry Development in the Southwestern Region' held at the Kim Dae-jung Convention Center in Seo-gu, Gwangju, the President stated, "The southwestern region will see the establishment of production facilities centered on advanced memory, advanced packaging production facilities, and AI data centers." He added, "We will launch the 'Korean-style artificial intelligence industrial revolution' right here in the southwestern region, where it will expand globally." The previous day, the presidential office announced at the 'National Report Meeting on the Three Mega Projects for Korea's Quantum Leap,' chaired by President Lee, that a total of 896 trillion won would be invested in the Honam region, including 800 trillion won for four semiconductor fabs, 1 trillion won for packaging, 87 trillion won for AI data centers, and 8 trillion won for smart home appliances and energy. <<> The President further noted, "In August, with the enforcement of the 'Special Semiconductor Act,' the 'Special Committee for Strengthening Semiconductor Industry Competitiveness' will be launched. As President, I will chair the committee and make it a powerful control tower for investments in the southwestern region." He emphasized, "I will establish a dedicated team at the presidential office and take full responsibility for supporting the entire process to ensure there is no delay, even for a month, after the plan is announced." <<> President Lee continued, "We will fully review regulations that hinder investment and boldly pursue fiscal and tax support." He added, "We will build an 'advanced industry talent development system' involving regional hub universities, investing companies, and research institutions. We will comprehensively support not only jobs but also housing, education, healthcare, and culture so that our young people can nurture and realize their dreams in the region." <<> President Lee emphasized that Honam is 'prepared land' for forming a semiconductor cluster. He said, "This southwestern region boasts the best and largest solar power and offshore wind power resources in the country, along with abundant renewable energy resources. The potential to massively supply the electricity, especially renewable energy, needed by future advanced industries lies right here." He added, "Its locational competitiveness is also outstanding. Large-scale industrial land adjacent to major city centers can be secured quickly and flexibly, and it is rapidly connected to anywhere domestically and internationally via KTX stations and Muan International Airport." <<> President Lee also referenced the saying 'Without Honam, there would be no country' meaning 'If not for Honam, the nation would cease to exist', noting, "Discrimination against Honam has created new opportunities." He said, "I will devote all my energy to spreading the innovation led by the southwestern region across all of South Korea, creating an 'irreplaceable South Korea' that the world needs and no other country can substitute." <<> Seo Young-ji Reporter yj@hani.co.kr (이 대통령은 이날 광주 서구 김대중컨벤션센터에서 열린 ‘서남권 첨단산업 발전비전 국민보고회’ 서면 축사를 통해 “서남권에는 첨단 메모리 중심의 생산 시설과 첨단 패키징 생산 시설, 그리고 에이아이(AI) 데이터센터가 조성된다”며 “지역이 주도해 전 세계로 뻗어나가는 ‘한국형 인공지능 산업혁명’을 바로 이곳 서남권에서 시작하겠다”고 말했다. 청와대는 전날 이 대통령이 주재한 ‘대한민국 대도약 3대 메가프로젝트 국민보고회’를 통해 호남권에 반도체 팹 4기 800조원, 패키징 1조원, 에이아이(AI) 데이터센터 87조원, 기타 스마트가전·에너지 8조원 등 총 896조원이 투자될 예정이라고 밝힌 바 있다.)

item.title: PPP’s Disciplinary Countdown Targets Pro-Han, Anti-Jang Dong-hyuk Factions… Tensions Rise Within Party (국힘, ‘친한계·반장동혁’ 표적 징계 카운트다운…당내 긴장 고조)
item.description:
The Central Ethics Committee of the People Power Party (PPP) is showing signs of resuming disciplinary actions against individuals perceived as opposing Representative Jang Dong-hyuk, heightening tensions within the party. <<> With the party’s Ethics Committee expected to convene around the 6th of next month, it has been reported that dozens of cases have been submitted to the committee as of the 30th. These include: lawmakers and district party branch chairs who supported independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon during the June 3 local elections; lawmakers from the internal “Alternatives and Future” group who repeatedly called for Representative Jang Dong-hyuk’s resignation; and individuals accused of misconduct in candidate nominations. <<> Earlier, on March 3, about 10 district party branch chairs, including Lee Sang-kyu, a special policy advisor to the party leader, submitted a request to the Ethics Committee to discipline lawmakers such as Kim Ye-ji, Ahn Sang-hoon, Jin Jong-oh, Jung Sung-kook, Bae Hyun-jin, Woo Jae-jun, and Park Jung-hoon, who had accompanied lawmaker Han Dong-hoon on his schedule in Daegu. On the 26th, Representative Jang Dong-hyuk criticized lawmakers Kim Jae-seop, Kim Yong-tae, and Woo Jae-jun by name on a YouTube broadcast, stating they were “shaking the party leadership without justification.” <<> The pro-Han faction is pushing back. Lawmaker Park Jung-hoon said on MBC Radio that day, “Those who should be disciplined themselves are trying to discipline others,” adding, “The disciplinary actions against Lawmaker Bae Hyun-jin and Supreme Council member Kim Jong-hyuk have already been nullified by the courts.” Woo Jae-jun, the Youth Supreme Council member, appeared on Channel A’s YouTube program and said, “It’s time to reflect on whether the disciplinary action against Lawmaker Han was right. Disciplining those who helped him will backfire.” <<> If the Ethics Committee votes on disciplinary measures, penalties such as recommendation to leave the party, suspension of party membership rights, or warnings will be finalized without a Supreme Council vote after a 10-day period for requesting a review. The harshest penalty, expulsion, requires approval from the Supreme Council. However, Chief Spokesperson Choi Bo-yoon stated, “The party’s Ethics Committee is an independent body, so the party leadership is not aware of its decisions.” <<> Meanwhile, it was reported that day that when independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon was invited to the Telegram group chat of the “National Assembly Global Diplomatic and Security Forum,” led by PPP lawmaker Yoon Jae-ok, and left a greeting, Representative Jang Dong-hyuk immediately left the group chat, drawing attention. The Global Diplomatic and Security Forum is a parliamentary research group involving lawmakers from both ruling and opposition parties. Within the party, some speculated that this reflected Representative Jang’s discomfort with Lawmaker Han. <<> Reporter Kim Hae-jung sea@hani.co.kr (국민의힘 중앙윤리위원회가 반장동혁 대표 성향의 인사들을 겨냥한 징계를 재개할 조짐을 보이면서 당내 긴장감이 고조되고 있다.)

item.title: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Meets Cho, Discusses North Korean Prisoner Issue in ‘Detailed and Constructive’ Talks (조현 만난 우크라 외교장관 “북한 포로 문제, 상세하고 건설적 논의”)
item.description:
The foreign ministers of South Korea and Ukraine discussed the issue of repatriating North Korean soldiers captured by Ukraine, as well as the reconstruction of Ukraine. (한국과 우크라이나 외교장관이 우크라이나에 붙잡힌 북한군 포로 송환 문제와 우크라이나 재건 문제 등을 논의했다.)

South Korean Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul met with Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs building on the 30th. The talks addressed the repatriation of two North Korean soldiers who were deployed to support Russia and subsequently captured by Ukrainian forces. (조현 외교부 장관은 30일 외교부 청사에서 안드리 시비하 우크라이나 외교장관과 회담했다. 회담에서는 러시아를 지원하기 위해 파병됐다가 우크라이나군에 붙잡힌 북한군 포로 2명의 송환 문제가 다뤄졌다.)

After the meeting, Minister Sybiha told reporters, “We discussed the issue of North Korean prisoners of war in detail. We know how to respond in accordance with international humanitarian law.” Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Park Il stated, “Regarding the issue of North Korean POWs, the two foreign ministers are having constructive discussions based on a consensus that this matter should be resolved in a manner consistent with international law and humanitarian principles. The government will continue to make diplomatic efforts for progress and resolution on the North Korean POW issue.” <<> The government maintains the position that it will accept the North Korean POWs, who are considered South Korean nationals under the Constitution and have expressed a desire to defect, and has continued consultations with the Ukrainian government toward this end. While the Ukrainian government agrees not to forcibly repatriate the North Korean soldiers to North Korea against their will, it is reportedly yet to decide on their transfer to South Korea, as it must also consider the disposition of prisoners from other countries besides North Korea. <<> The two ministers also discussed responses to the growing alignment between North Korea and Russia, enhancing South Korea-Ukraine security cooperation, and the participation of South Korean companies in Ukraine’s reconstruction. <<> After the talks, Minister Sybiha posted on X, stating, “We discussed common challenges arising from the deepening cooperation between Russia and North Korea. I thanked South Korea for its continued support and also mentioned the global impact of Russia’s aggression, including Russia’s involvement of North Korea in the war and everything Russia has provided to North Korea in return.” He added, “We discussed ways to develop high-level political dialogue, expand economic and industrial solidarity, and advance security cooperation while South Korean companies participate in Ukraine’s reconstruction.” <<> Spokesperson Park Il also commented, “The government has been supporting Ukraine in various sectors such as energy, infrastructure, health, medical care, and education, and has actively participated in international efforts to alleviate the humanitarian crisis. We will continue our support efforts.” <<> Prior to the meeting, Minister Sybiha visited the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ). He wrote on X, “Standing at South Korea’s DMZ, it becomes very clear that global security is interconnected. Because of the dangerous actions of Pyongyang and Moscow, this historic line is now physically linked to our front lines in Ukraine.” He further stated, “Russia is dragging North Korea into its war against Ukraine and empowering the Pyongyang regime, exporting instability to the Korean Peninsula. Meanwhile, Ukraine is ready to export security and share its own experience. I propose a mutually beneficial security partnership to our South Korean partners.” Minister Sybiha also attended a business roundtable hosted by the Korea Overseas Infrastructure & Urban Development Corporation (KIND), where he discussed economic cooperation between the two countries, noting that “Ukraine’s combat-proven drone technology and dynamic defense industry offer tremendous synergies in both security and civilian sectors.” <<> Senior Correspondent Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr (시비하 장관은 회담을 마친 뒤 기자들에게 “북한 전쟁포로 문제에 대해 상세히 논의했다. 국제 인도법에 따라 어떻게 대응할지 알고 있다”고 말했다. 박일 외교부 대변인은 “북한군 포로 문제와 관련해 양국 외교 수장은 이 사안이 국제법과 인도주의 원칙에 부합하는 방식으로 해결돼야 한다는 공감대 아래에서 건설적인 논의를 하고 있다”며 “정부는 앞으로도 계속해서 북한군 포로 문제의 진전과 해결을 위한 외교적인 노력을 경주해 나갈 것”이라고 말했다.)

item.title: Fourth Launch of Solid-Fuel Space Launch Vehicle Delayed…"Issue Found During Final Preparations" (고체추진 우주발사체 4차 발사 연기…“최종 준비 중 문제 발견”)
item.description:
The fourth test launch of a solid-fuel space launch vehicle was delayed just before liftoff. (고체연료 추진 우주발사체 4차 시험발사가 발사 직전 연기됐다.)

The Ministry of National Defense stated on the 30th, "The test launch of the solid-fuel space launch vehicle scheduled for today was called off due to safety concerns after some problems were discovered during the final launch preparations." The test launch was planned for around 2 PM that day in waters near Jeju Island. However, a decision to halt was made just before the launch. A defense ministry official said, "We are looking into the detailed cause." A rescheduled launch date has not yet been set. (국방부는 30일 “이날 예정됐던 고체추진 우주발사체 시험발사는 최종 발사 준비 중 일부 문제점이 발견됨에 따라 안전을 고려해 발사 중지를 결정했다”고 밝혔다. 우주발사체 시험발사는 이날 오후 2시께 제주 인근 해상에서 할 예정이었다. 그러나 발사 직전 중단 결정이 내려졌다. 국방부 관계자는 “세부원인을 파악하고 있다”고 말했다. 재발사 일정은 아직 정해지지 않았다.)

A solid-fuel launch vehicle is a space launch vehicle that uses solid fuel instead of liquid fuel as propellant. Solid-fuel launch vehicles have simpler structures and are easier to store and handle. Their launch preparation period is also short, within seven days, allowing for rapid launches. Launch costs are also lower compared to liquid-fuel rockets. (고체추진 발사체는 액체연료 대신 고체연료를 추진제로 활용하는 우주발사체다. 고체 연료 발사체는 구조가 단순하고 저장과 취급이 용이하다. 발사 준비 기간 역시 7일 이내로 짧아 신속한 발사가 가능하다. 발사 비용도 액체연료 로켓에 비해 적다.)

For this reason, solid-fuel launch vehicle technology allows for quick response when additional military reconnaissance satellites need to be launched in a national crisis, making it highly valuable for military use. The military authorities plan to use the Korean solid-fuel space launch vehicle to launch micro reconnaissance satellites in the future. (이 때문에 고체연료 발사체 기술은 국가 위기 상황에서 군사정찰위성 추가 발사가 필요할 때 빠르게 대처할 수 있어 군사적 활용도가 높다. 군 당국은 앞으로 한국형 고체연료 우주발사체를 활용해 초소형 정찰위성을 발사할 계획이다.)

The military authorities began developing the technology, led by the Agency for Defense Development (ADD), after the lifting of restrictions on solid-fuel propulsion for space launch vehicles with the abolition of the 'Korea-U.S. Missile Guidelines' in May 2021. Previously, they successfully conducted three test launches: in March 2022 (1st), December 2022 (2nd), and December 2023 (3rd). (군 당국은 2021년 5월 ‘한미 미사일 지침’ 해제로 우주발사체의 고체연료 추진 제한이 사라지면서 국방과학연구소(ADD) 주도로 기술 개발에 착수했다. 앞서 2022년 3월(1차)과 12월(2차), 2023년 12월(3차) 등 모두 3차례 시험발사에 성공했다.)

Reporter Kwon Hyuk-chul nura@hani.co.kr (권혁철 기자 nura@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic Party Mired in ‘Grave Exhumation’ Debate…Song Young-gil: “Jung Cheong-rae Was the Vanguard Opposing the Korea-U.S. FTA” (‘파묘’ 논쟁 휩싸인 민주당…송영길 “정청래, 한미 FTA 반대 선봉장”)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae, a former representative likely to run in the August 17 Democratic Party of Korea leadership election, and lawmaker Song Young-gil engaged in a war of nerves on the 30th over the pros and cons of the Korea-U.S. Free Trade Agreement (FTA) pushed during the participatory government. Within the party, concerns are rising that the leadership contest is devolving into a ‘grave exhumation’ debate, digging up past actions amid a legitimacy dispute. <<> Song apologized on this day via his Facebook and an interview with YTN for his previous day’s claim that Jung had “completely turned his back on former President Roh Moo-hyun” and could not attend his funeral in 2009. He said, “I said he didn’t even attend the funeral because I have no memory of seeing him that day. It was a mistake. I admit it cleanly and apologize.” <<> However, separate from the apology, Song launched an offensive by criticizing Jung’s stance on the Korea-U.S. FTA during the participatory government. <<> Song stated, “When the late former President Roh Moo-hyun pushed for the Korea-U.S. FTA, most Democratic Party lawmakers fiercely opposed it. At the forefront was lawmaker Jung Cheong-rae. I consistently supported the push for the Korea-U.S. FTA.” The participatory government concluded the Korea-U.S. FTA in 2007. Song also wrote on Facebook, “Now is the era of Lee Jae-myung. The true successors of Roh Moo-hyun are not Jung Cheong-rae, Kim Min-seok, or Song Young-gil, but the awakened citizens who are determined to protect and make President Lee Jae-myung, the second Roh Moo-hyun, successful, and never let the tragedy of the late President Roh repeat.” He visited Bongha Village this day and paid respects at Roh’s grave. <<> In response, former Representative Jung expressed strong displeasure. He wrote on his Facebook, “I have never uttered the word ‘legitimacy’ or heirs with my own mouth. I wish people wouldn’t imagine and twist what I haven’t said. Let’s not engage in wasteful legitimacy debates.” Lawmaker Choi Min-hee, classified as a pro-Jung figure, also said, “Wasn’t the post-election committee incident an attempt to kill candidate Roh Moo-hyun? Can’t we avoid this biased grave exhumation? If someone digs this up, who benefits and who loses?” The post-election committee incident referred to internal party strife in the 2002 presidential election sparked by the push for a unified candidacy between Roh Moo-hyun and Chung Mong-joon, with then-Prime Minister Kim Min-seok being one of the key figures driving the discussion. <<> Former Representative Jung also counterattacked Song, who had argued the previous day that “adjustments by generation and region are needed” for the one-person-one-vote system, saying, “Who is challenging the one-person-one-vote system? Don’t shake things up.” <<> Concerns emerged within the party, particularly among senior members. Former National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik urged, “We must immediately stop the language of contempt and division that wounds internal opponents and splits support bases.” Lawmaker Park Jee-won said, “We must unite to survive. Digging up graves will kill everyone.” <<> Amid this, President Lee Jae-myung praised Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, who attended what was virtually his last Cabinet meeting, saying, “There have been many achievements by the government, but I think Prime Minister Kim Min-seok’s role was the greatest.” <<> Meanwhile, the Democratic Party’s Convention Preparation Committee decided to apply the one-person-one-vote system for delegates and party members in this convention, with a 70:30 ratio reflecting delegate and party member votes and public opinion polls. The committee plans to hold a nationwide primary starting from the Chungcheong region on August 1, followed by a national party convention in Daejeon on the 17th to determine the final winner. <<> Reporters: Jung Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr, Ko Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr, Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (8·17 더불어민주당 전당대회 대표 선거 출마가 유력한 정청래 전 대표와 송영길 의원이 30일 참여정부 때 추진한 한-미 자유무역협정(FTA) 찬반을 두고 신경전을 벌였다. 당내에서는 전대가 적통 논쟁에 과거 행적을 들추는 ‘파묘’ 논쟁으로 흐르는 데 대한 우려가 제기된다.)

item.title: President Lee Refutes 'Honam Favoritism,' Says "Site Selection Based on Economic Principles" (‘호남 특혜’ 반박한 이 대통령 “경제적 원리 따라 입지 선정”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, addressing the 896 trillion won investment plans by Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, including a semiconductor cluster in the southwestern region, personally visited Gwangju on the 30th and promised, "I will take direct jurisdiction and ensure final accountability." In a Cabinet meeting earlier that day, President Lee directly refuted claims of regional favoritism, stating, "While it's true there is a lot of investment in Honam, compared to the historically accumulated investment amounts, it is merely 'a drop in the bucket' (like the blood from a bird's foot)." <<> President Lee attended the 'National Report on the Development Vision for Advanced Industries in the Southwestern Region' held at the Kim Dae-jung Convention Center in Seo-gu, Gwangju, on the afternoon of the same day. He stated, "There are various disagreements regarding site selection, but it is clear it was based on economic principles," adding, "Considering water supply, electricity, land, and infrastructure, the Honam region is the only area capable of solving the (semiconductor shortage) problem." The day prior, the presidential office announced through the 'National Report on Three Mega-Projects for Korea's Great Leap Forward,' chaired by President Lee, that a total of 896 trillion won would be invested in the Honam region. This includes 800 trillion won for the 4th semiconductor fab, 1 trillion won for packaging, 87 trillion won for AI data centers, and 8 trillion won for other areas like smart home appliances and energy. <<> At the Cabinet meeting held at the presidential office that morning, President Lee emphasized the three mega-projects as "the key to unlocking 'growth for everyone,' where the entire nation enjoys balanced development." In the afternoon's national report meeting, he referenced the phrase 'If there were no Honam, there would be no nation,' and stated, "Discrimination against Honam created new opportunities." President Lee further emphasized, "I consider this a historical and national compensation to Honam, which endured the pain and sorrow of discrimination without any reward or compensation, building and protecting the democracy of the Republic of Korea. We will ensure its success without any setbacks." <<> President Lee repeatedly highlighted the feasibility of the investment plan. He said, "Originally, it seems (Samsung and SK) planned to finish the Yongin project first and then discuss (Honam) in the next phase. But since demand is surging now, I suggested pursuing them simultaneously." He then asked Executive Vice Chairman Jeon Young-hyun of Samsung Electronics and President Kwak Noh-jeong of SK Hynix, who were present, "You agreed, right?" The two nodded. President Lee added, "To facilitate large-scale investment in Honam, we guided them, to put it nicely, or induced them, to put it bluntly. There was no suppression or coercion." He concluded, "The most rewarding thing was creating this environment by fine-tuning government policies and eliciting the companies' decision." This clearly drew a line against the perception in some quarters that the Honam investment was a result of government pressure, clarifying it was a voluntary decision by the companies. <<> President Lee emphasized, "I truly want to show that this (investment) is genuine and not just a policy show or a spectacle," adding, "The government will do its utmost, whether through financial support, infrastructure construction, or creating the best living, educational, cultural, and healthcare conditions." Mentioning Min Hyeong-bae, the governor-elect of the integrated South Jeolla-Gwangju Special Metropolitan City, who begins his term on July 1st, President Lee said, "Min has promised to use up to 20 trillion won if needed to secure essential infrastructure." <<> President Lee will also personally attend the national report on the development vision for advanced industries in the Chungcheong region, to be held on the 2nd in Asan, South Chungcheong Province, and the national report for the Yeongnam region, to be held on the 3rd in Jinju, South Gyeongsang Province. Samsung, SK Hynix, and Celltrion are scheduled to participate in the Chungcheong region report, while Samsung, SK Telecom, Hyundai Motor, and Hanwha are expected to participate in the Yeongnam region report. <<> Seo Young-ji, reporter yj@hani.co.kr Koh Kyung-joo, reporter goh@hani.co.kr (이재명 대통령이 896조원 규모의 반도체 클러스터 등 삼성전자·에스케이(SK)하이닉스의 서남권 투자 계획과 관련, 30일 광주를 직접 찾아 “제가 직접 관할해서 최종 책임을 확실히 지겠다”고 약속했다. 이 대통령은 이날 오전 국무회의에서는 “호남에 투자가 많은 건 사실이나 역사적으로 누적된 투자량을 비교한다면 조족지혈(새발의 피)에 불과하다”며 호남 특혜론을 정면 반박했다.)

item.title: Democratic Party Submits Candidates for 11 Committee Chairs… People Power Party Objects with ‘Resignation Letters’ (민주, 11개 상임위원장 후보 제출…국힘, ‘사임계’ 반발)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea submitted a list of candidates to the National Assembly on the 30th to elect chairs for 11 of the 18 standing committees in the latter half of the 22nd National Assembly, all of which would be held by Democratic Party members. This decision was made unilaterally by the Democratic Party as negotiations between the ruling and opposition parties for the latter half's organizational structure repeatedly broke down. (더불어민주당이 22대 국회 후반기 18개 상임위원회 가운데 11개 위원회 위원장을 민주당 소속으로 선출하기 위한 후보 명단을 30일 국회에 제출했다. 후반기 원구성을 위한 여야 협상이 파행을 거듭하면서 민주당 주도로 이러한 결정을 한 것이다.)

The Democratic Party announced the list of candidates for the chairs of standing committees for the latter half of the 22nd National Assembly on the afternoon of the same day, recommending four-term lawmaker Seo Young-gyo as the candidate for the Legislation and Judiciary Committee chair. For the Political Affairs Committee chair, the party selected Yoo Dong-soo, and for the Strategy and Finance Committee chair, Cho Seung-rae. Song Ki-heon was recommended for the Science, Technology, Information, Broadcasting, and Communications Committee chair, Jin Seong-jun for the National Defense Committee chair, and Kim Young-jin for the Public Administration and Security Committee chair. Lee Jae-jeong was named as the candidate for the Culture, Sports, and Tourism Committee chair, Seo Sam-seok for the Agriculture, Food, Rural Affairs, and Maritime Affairs Committee chair, and Kim Jeong-ho for the Climate, Energy, Environment, and Labor Committee chair. Floor leader Han Byung-do was nominated for the Steering Committee chair, and Lee Kwang-jae for the Special Committee on Budget and Accounts. <<> In response, People Power Party floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik criticized the Democratic Party, stating, "This is old-fashioned backroom politics where they decide among themselves how to divide up the committees." The People Power Party also objected to National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik's compulsory appointment and notification of members to the 11 committees, submitting resignation letters for their committee members. <<> By Choi Ha-yeon chy@hani.co.kr and Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (민주당은 이날 오후 법제사법위원장 후보로 4선 서영교 의원을 추천하는 22대 국회 후반기 상임위원회 위원장 후보 명단을 발표했다. 민주당은 정무위원장 후보로 유동수 의원, 재정경제위원장 후보로 조승래 의원을 선정했다. 과학기술정보방송통신위원장 후보에는 송기헌 의원, 국방위원장 후보에는 진성준 의원, 행정안전위원장 후보에는 김영진 의원을 추천했다. 문화체육관광위원장 후보로는 이재정 의원, 농림축산식품해양수산위원장후보로는 서삼석 의원, 기후에너지환경노동위원장 후보로는 김정호 의원이 이름을 올렸다. 운영위원장 후보에는 한병도 원내대표가, 예산결산특별위원장 후보에는 이광재 의원이 지명됐다.)

item.title: President Lee boards helicopter to inspect Gwangju military airport and offshore wind power complex (헬기 탄 이 대통령, 광주 군공항·해상풍력 발전단지 시찰)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung attended the ‘Southwest Region Advanced Industry Development Vision National Report Meeting’ held in Gwangju on the 30th, and then toured the Southwest region industrial complex candidate sites and offshore wind power complex by helicopter. <<> Deputy Spokesperson Ahn Gwi-ryeong reported that President Lee first inspected the Gwangju military airport site, which is being pursued for relocation to Muan, Jeollanam-do, while receiving a briefing from Deputy Minister of National Defense Lee Doo-hee. Next, President Lee toured the Gwangju future mobility industrial complex candidate site, receiving a briefing from Cheong Wa Dae Policy Chief Kim Yong-beom. Policy Chief Kim explained the plan to develop an industrial complex of approximately 1 million pyeong (about 3.3 square kilometers), and President Lee reviewed the transportation infrastructure, noting its accessibility within 20 minutes from Gwangju Songjeong Station and Gwangju Airport. <<> President Lee also visited Haenam Solarsido, a future-oriented city combining advanced industries, solar energy, and AI data centers. President Lee examined the site conditions and power supply infrastructure, inquiring about the potential use of remaining industrial land in the district. Deputy Spokesperson Ahn reported that Secretary Kim explained: “Over 300,000 pyeong of industrial land is available, and various developments are possible by attracting advanced industries.” <<> President Lee also toured Mokpo New Port, a key hub for installing offshore wind power in the southwestern region. Minister of Climate, Energy, and Environment Kim Seong-hwan explained that “Mokpo New Port is a forward base for offshore wind power installation, equipped with infrastructure capable of handling ultra-large offshore wind power structures.” <<> In addition, President Lee visited Sinan Anjwosol City, where a 288-megawatt (MW) solar power facility was built on reclaimed land with high salinity, making agriculture difficult. Anjwosol City produces enough electricity (350,000 MWh) annually for about 100,000 households, and Minister Kim explained that the power generation profits are shared with residents through local gift vouchers and sunlight child allowances, contributing to revitalizing the local economy and addressing regional extinction. <<> President Lee also inspected the currently operating Jeollanam-do offshore wind power complex and the Yeonggwang Nakhwal offshore wind power complex, the largest under construction in the country. Deputy Spokesperson Ahn stated, “Through this inspection, President Lee directly reviewed the advanced industries and energy infrastructure of the southwestern region, confirming the region’s future growth foundation.” <<> Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (이재명 대통령이 30일 광주에서 열린 ‘서남권 첨단산업 발전 비전 국민보고회’에 참석한 뒤 서남권 산업단지 후보지와 해상풍력 발전단지 등을 헬기를 타고 시찰했다.)

item.title: Democratic Party leads election of 10 standing committee chairs and Budget Committee chair for second half of term (민주당 주도로 후반기 상임위원장 10명·예결위원장 선출)
item.description:
Under the leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea, chairs for 11 out of 18 standing and permanent special committees in the second half of the 22nd National Assembly were elected from among lawmakers of the Democratic Party. The People Power Party strongly objected, calling it "old-fashioned backroom politics," and boycotted the National Assembly plenary session vote to elect the standing committee chairs. item.title: Prime Minister nominee Han Seong-sook's confirmation motion passes... People Power Party abstains from voting (한성숙 총리 후보 임명동의안 가결…국힘 투표 불참)
item.description:
The National Assembly has approved the confirmation motion for Prime Minister nominee Han Seong-sook. (국회가 한성숙 국무총리 후보자 임명동의안을 가결했다.)

The National Assembly held a plenary session on the 30th and passed the confirmation motion for Prime Minister nominee Han Seong-sook with 166 votes in favor and 1 invalid vote out of 167 lawmakers present. (국회는 30일 본회의를 열어 한성숙 총리 후보자에 대한 임명동의안을 재석의원 167명 중 찬성 166표, 무효 1표로 가결 처리했다.)

The People Power Party opposed the agenda item and did not participate in the vote. After leaving the plenary session hall and convening a general meeting of lawmakers, People Power Party floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik met with reporters and said, "We judge that (Han) the prime minister is unqualified. Since we have already clearly expressed our opposition to the prime minister confirmation, we will not participate in the confirmation vote." (국민의힘은 안건 상정에 반대하며 투표에 참여하지 않았다. 이날 본회의장에서 빠져나와 의원총회를 소집한 정점식 국민의힘 원내대표는 회의 뒤 취재진을 만나 “(한) 총리에 대해 저희는 부적격이라 판단한다. 총리 인준안에 대해 반대 의사를 이미 명확히 했기 때문에 인준 투표에 들어가지 않을 것”이라고 말했다.)

If President Lee Jae-myung approves the appointment of nominee Han, she will officially begin her term as prime minister. (이재명 대통령이 한 후보자의 임명안을 재가하면 한 후보자는 총리로서 공식 임기를 시작하게 된다.)

item.title: People Power Party cries "unilateral assembly formation" while Democrats say "we've endured enough" (국힘 “일방통행 원 구성” 반발에…민주 “참을 만큼 참아”)
item.description:
The political landscape is rapidly cooling as the People Power Party (PPP) strongly protests the election of Democratic Party of Korea (DP) lawmakers as chairs of 10 standing committees, including the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, and the Special Committee on Budget and Accounts for the second half of the 22nd National Assembly during a plenary session on the 30th. <<> Tensions escalated when the DP, after negotiations on the assembly formation collapsed around 6 p.m., announced the list of its lawmakers who would serve as chairs of the 10 standing committees and the Budget and Accounts Special Committee, and proceeded to a floor vote. DP floor leader Han Byung-do said at a general meeting of lawmakers before the plenary session, "We have endured enough" and added, "Starting tomorrow, we will immediately convene each standing committee, finalize the selection of secretaries and subcommittee formation, and launch into a legislative war." <<> However, PPP floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik said at a general meeting held before the plenary session, "This is an arrogant politics and outdated backroom politics that shows no respect for the minority party." After the meeting, he told reporters, "We will not respond to a unilateral assembly formation that hands out crumbs." <<> PPP lawmakers visited the speaker's office in protest, demanding a postponement of the plenary session. However, National Assembly Speaker Chung Jin-suk, after unilaterally selecting and notifying the PPP lawmakers to belong to the 11 standing committees and the Budget and Accounts Special Committee where the DP would take the chair, convened the plenary session. <<> The PPP promptly submitted resignation letters for all its lawmakers on those committees to the National Assembly's administrative office and staged a protest on the floor of the plenary session. PPP lawmakers, holding placards reading "Unchecked assembly formation" and "DP-style intimidation of the public," chanted slogans such as "Condemn the DP for parliamentary dictatorship and forced committee formation" before refusing to participate in the vote for committee chairs and walking out of the plenary chamber. <<> The PPP strongly opposed, in particular, the election of Rep. Seo Young-kyo as chair of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, which had been the biggest point of contention in the negotiations. DP Chief Deputy Floor Leader Chun Jun-ho explained the background of selecting Rep. Seo as the committee chair, saying, "(Rep. Seo) served as the committee chair for about three months in the first half of the session and had several reform tasks she had been pushing since then. We judged it appropriate to temporarily extend her role with continuity and consistency until key reform tasks, including prosecutorial reform, are completed." <<> In response, PPP floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik drew a hard line, saying, "The DP's claim of creating a 'working parliament' is a blatant lie. This is a reappointment to comply with (President Lee Jae-myung's) order to pass a special counsel law on the dismissal of a prosecution case." The PPP plans to hold a general meeting of lawmakers on the 2nd to decide on future responses, including a potential boycott of the National Assembly. <<> Reports by Choi Ha-yan, Jang Na-rae, Jo Hee-yeon, and Kim Chae-un at chy@hani.co.kr <<> (30일 국회 본회의에서 22대 국회 후반기 법제사법원회를 포함한 10개 상임위원회 위원장과 예산결산특별위원장에 더불어민주당 의원들이 선출된 데 대해 국민의힘이 강력히 반발하면서 정국이 급속히 냉각되고 있다.)

item.title: President Lee Approves Appointment of Han Seong-suk as Prime Minister (이 대통령, 한성숙 국무총리 임명안 재가)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung approved the appointment of Han Seong-suk as Prime Minister on the 30th, according to Senior Press Secretary Kang Yu-jeong. (이재명 대통령이 30일 한성숙 국무총리 임명안을 재가했다고 강유정 수석대변인이 밝혔다.)

Senior Press Secretary Kang stated, “The effective date of Prime Minister Han’s appointment is July 1st.” (강 수석대변인은 “한 총리의 임명일자는 7월1일”이라고 말했다.)

The National Assembly passed the appointment consent motion for candidate Han in a plenary session on the same day, with 166 votes in favor and 1 invalid vote out of 167 attending lawmakers. (국회는 이날 본회의에서 한 후보자에 대한 임명동의안을 재석의원 167명 중 찬성 166표, 무효 1표로 가결 처리했다.)

The People Power Party opposed the agenda item and boycotted the vote. (국민의힘은 안건 상정에 반대하며 표결에 불참했다.)

The passage of candidate Han’s appointment motion comes 23 days after President Lee nominated her as the prime ministerial candidate. As a result, candidate Han will be inaugurated as the second prime minister of the Lee Jae-myung administration and the 50th prime minister overall. item.title: [Exclusive] “Print Ballots for 100% of Voters”... Election Commission Reports Measures to Special Committee ([단독] “투표용지, 선거인 100% 인쇄”…선관위, 국조특위에 대책 보고)
item.description:
The National Election Commission (NEC) has reported to the Special Committee on the Parliamentary Investigation into the June 3 Local Elections Ballot Shortage a set of institutional improvements, including calculating the number of ballots printed as 100% of the electorate and being subject to parliamentary oversight. (중앙선거관리위원회가 투표용지 인쇄매수를 선거인 수의 100%를 원칙으로 계산하고 국회의 감시를 받는 내용의 제도 개선책을 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족사태 국정조사특별위원회에 보고했다.)

According to an institutional report submitted by the NEC to the office of Representative Kim Nam-hee of the Democratic Party of Korea, a member of the special committee, on the 1st, the NEC has prepared improvement measures. From the second half of this year, the number of ballots printed will be calculated based on the principle of 100% of the number of voters as of the date the voter list is compiled, and any reduction will require a resolution by the central commission. Regulations for additional printing using ballot issuance machines and procedures for additional ballot distribution will also be established to prepare for emergency situations on election day. (1일 국조특위 소속 김남희 더불어민주당 의원실이 중앙선관위로부터 제출받은 기관보고를 보면, 선관위는 올해 하반기부터 투표용지 인쇄매수를 선거인명부 작성일 기준 선거인 수의 100% 원칙으로 산정하되, 축소하는 경우 중앙위원회 의결을 거치도록 하는 내용의 개선 대책을 마련했다. 선거일 비상상황을 대비해 투표용지발급기를 이용한 추가인쇄 근거 규정과 투표용지 추가배부 절차 규정도 마련하기로 했다.)

Additionally, the NEC outlined plans to build a comprehensive voting management system. This will enable voting managers, administrative staff at the town/township/district level, and election commissions at various levels to report, disseminate, and control situations in real time via a mobile web platform. Functions will include: △Current voter turnout △Remaining ballot status △Voting progress (smooth, many waiting, etc.) △Hotline connection with local and central election commissions in emergencies △Recording of unusual events or major incidents △Search for major announcements and procedural processing. (또 투표관리종합 시스템을 구축하겠다는 구상을 밝혔다. 투표 관리관 및 읍면동 간사·서기, 각급 선거관리위원회가 실시간으로 상황보고 및 전파, 관제가 가능하도록 모바일 웹에 △투표자 수 현황 △잔여투표용지 현황 △투표진행 상태(원활·대기자 수 많음 등) △긴급 상황 시 일선 선관위와 중앙선관위와의 핫라인 전화 연결 △특이사항이나 주요 사건사고 기록 △주요 공지사항 및 절차처리 검색 등의 기능을 넣는 방식이다.)

Furthermore, to strengthen the accountability of the commission, the NEC's highest decision-making body, by the first half of next year, the NEC has decided to review organizational redesign plans, including making the chairperson a full-time position and introducing multiple standing commissioners. Currently, only one of the nine NEC commissioners is full-time. (아울러 내년 상반기까지 선관위의 최고 의사결정기구인 위원회의 책임성을 강화하기 위해 위원장 상근제와 복수의 상임위원을 두는 등 조직 재설계 방안을 검토하기로 했다. 현재는 9명의 선관위원 중 1명만 상근하고 있다.)

Measures to be subject to parliamentary oversight have also been prepared. The NEC's audit committee, currently a deliberative body under existing regulations, will be legislated as an independent decision-making body based on a collegial system, and audit results will be reported to the National Assembly. Additionally, after elections, an independent 'Election Management Evaluation Committee' (tentative name) will be established under the relevant standing committee of the National Assembly to conduct post-election evaluations, with results made public. (국회의 감시를 받는 방안도 마련했다. 현행 규칙상 심의기구인 선관위 감사위원회를 독립된 합의제 의결기구로 법제화하고 감사 결과를 국회에 보고하기로 했다. 또 선거 후 국회 소관 상임위 산하에 독립적인 ‘선거관리평가위원회’(가칭)를 설치하고 선거관리 사후평가를 받고 그 결과를 국민에게 공개할 방침이다.)

To ensure stable election management, the NEC will also promote the operation of a pan-governmental consultative body. Starting 100 days before election day, the NEC, the Ministry of the Interior and Safety, and other relevant agencies will operate a consultative body to establish a response system for securing personnel, facilities, and equipment, responding to emergencies, and providing on-site support. (안정적인 선거관리를 위해 범정부적 협의체 운영도 추진하기로 했다. 선거일 100일 전부터 중앙선관위와 행전안전부를 비롯한 관계기관이 협의체를 운영하고, 인력·시설·장비 확보, 비상상황 대응, 현장지원 등 대응체계를 구축할 계획이다.)

Representative Kim Nam-hee stated, “The ballot shortage was not a simple administrative error but a major failure in election management that threatened citizens’ right to vote,” adding, “Through this parliamentary investigation, we will clarify accountability and thoroughly check the election management system to ensure that no voter’s right to vote is violated again.” (김남희 의원은 “투표용지 부족은 단순한 행정착오가 아니라 국민의 참정권을 위협한 중대한 선거관리 실패”라며 “국정조사를 통해 책임 소재를 분명히 하고, 다시는 단 한 명의 유권자도 투표권을 침해받지 않도록 선거관리 체계를 끝까지 점검하겠다”고 말했다.)

The second institutional report session of the Special Committee on the Parliamentary Investigation into the June 3 Local Elections Ballot Shortage, to be held at the National Assembly on this day, will be attended by Jo Hyeon-uk, head of the NEC Fact-Finding Committee, former NEC Chairperson Noh Tae-ak, eight current NEC commissioners, and Minister of the Interior and Safety Yoon Ho-joong. (이날 국회에서 열리는 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족사태 국정조사특별위원회 2차 기관보고에는 조현욱 중앙선관위 진상규명위원장, 노태악 전 중앙선관위원장과 현직 선관위원 8명, 윤호중 행정안전부 장관 등이 출석할 예정이다.)

Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr (정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr)

item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung will invite former President Moon Jae-in to the Cheong Wa Dae State Guest House for a lunch on the 1st. (이재명 대통령이 1일 문재인 전 대통령을 청와대 영빈관으로 초청해 오찬을 함께한다.)

Cheong Wa Dae revealed the lunch menu, stating that it was composed of dishes symbolizing the ‘harmony’ and ‘unity’ that President Lee and former President Moon have always emphasized. First, the lunch will include suranchae (a cold noodle dish with assorted vegetables) in consideration of former President Moon, who enjoys seafood, and President Lee, who hails from Andong. Additionally, as high-end summer health foods, dishes such as mung bean samgyejuk (chicken and ginseng porridge), buckwheat and napa cabbage jeon (pan-fried pancake), john dory fish jeon, and zucchini and shrimp jeon have been prepared. Cheong Wa Dae explained, “It is a jeon set that brings together john dory fish, a summer seasonal fish from the South Sea favored by former President Moon, who likes fish, with napa cabbage jeon, which President Lee likes, all arranged harmoniously on one plate.” (청와대는 이날 오찬 메뉴를 공개하며 이 대통령과 문 전 대통령이 항상 강조해 온 ‘화합’과 ‘통합’을 상징하는 요리로 구성했다고 밝혔다. 먼저 오찬에는 해산물을 좋아하는 문 전 대통령과 안동이 고향인 이 대통령을 위해 수란채가 오른다. 또 고급 여름 보양식으로 토종닭과 인삼을 이용한 녹두 삼계죽과 메밀 배추전, 달고기전과 애호박새우전도 준비했다. 청와대는 “생선을 좋아하는 문 전 대통령을 위한 남해 여름 제철 생선인 달고기, 이 대통령이 좋아하는 배추전을 한 접시에 모아 조화롭게 내놓은 전 세트”라고 말했다.)

Also prepared are grilled Korean beef short rib braised ribs, bibimbap symbolizing unity, and min-eo-tang (croaker fish soup), a summer seasonal dish. (또 한우 갈비찜 구이와 통합을 상징하는 비빔밥과 여름 제철 음식인 민어탕 등도 준비됐다.)

For dessert, items such as assorted rice cakes and fruit hwachae (fruit punch) have been arranged, imbued with the meaning of unity and harmony. Cheong Wa Dae stated, “The hwachae was prepared recalling the memory of when First Lady Kim Jung-sook made fruit punch with fallen fruits from flood-affected areas around this time in 2017 and offered it to Cheong Wa Dae staff and reporters.” (후식에도 통합과 화합의 의미를 담아 모둠떡과 과일화채 등이 오른다. 청와대는 “화채는 2017년 이맘때, 김정숙 여사가 수해지역 낙과로 화채를 만들어 청와대 참모진, 기자 등에게 제공했던 기억을 떠올리며 준비했다”고 말했다.)

However, First Lady Kim Jung-sook will not attend the lunch due to overseas schedule. (다만 김정숙 여사는 해외 일정 때문에 이날 오찬에 참석하지 않는다.)

Chief of Staff Hong Ik-pyo of Cheong Wa Dae previously stated on the 27th of last month regarding this lunch, “We expect it to be a meaningful occasion to hear valuable advice from the former president for the recovery of people’s livelihoods, national unity, and the success of the people’s sovereignty government, and to exchange opinions openly on overall state affairs.” (홍익표 청와대 정무수석은 지난달 27일 이날 오찬에 대해 “민생 회복과 국민 통합, 그리고 국민주권정부의 성공을 위해 전직 대통령으로부터 고견을 듣고, 국정 전반에 대해 허심탄회하게 의견을 나누는 뜻깊은 자리가 될 것으로 기대한다”고 밝힌 바 있다.)

Meanwhile, President Lee is scheduled to hold a dinner with floor leader Han Byeong-do of the Democratic Party of Korea and other floor leaders in the evening. (한편 이 대통령은 이날 저녁에는 한병도 더불어민주당 원내대표 등 원내대표단과 만찬을 할 예정이다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: ‘Citizen Participation Work Report’ to Be Held for Three Days from the 15th… Recruiting 200 Observers (15일부터 사흘간 ‘국민 참여 업무보고’…200명 참관단 모집)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung is recruiting 200 citizens to serve as an observation group for the second live-streamed work report, which will take place over four days from the 15th to the 21st. (이재명 대통령이 오는 15일부터 21일 사이 나흘간 진행되는 2차 생중계 업무보고에 참여할 국민 참관단 200명을 모집한다.)

On the 1st, President Lee posted on Facebook an article titled “Starting the First Ministerial Work Report Together with the Government and the People,” stating, “We await 200 citizens to join us as an observation group for the work report of the People’s Sovereignty Government.” (이 대통령은 1일 페이스북에 ‘정부와 국민이 함께하는 첫 부처 업무보고를 시작합니다’라는 제목의 글을 올려 “국민주권정부의 부처 업무보고에 함께 해주실 200분의 국민 참관단 여러분을 기다린다”고 말했다.)

President Lee said, “This work report is not a one-sided presentation of achievements, but a place to review policy outcomes together with the people and discuss the future direction of state affairs,” adding, “We hope to directly examine how policies are being implemented in people’s lives and furthermore gather wisdom for a better tomorrow.” Applications can be submitted from 9 a.m. on the same day until 12 p.m. on the 6th via the link posted on President Lee’s Facebook. (이 대통령은 “이번 업무보고는 일방적으로 성과를 발표하는 것이 아닌, 국민 여러분과 함께 정책의 성과를 확인하고 앞으로의 국정 방향을 논의하는 자리”라며 “정책이 국민의 삶 속에서 어떻게 구현되고 있는지 직접 살피고, 나아가 더 나은 내일을 위한 지혜를 한 데 모을 수 있길 기대한다”고 말했다. 신청은 이날 오전 9시부터 6일 12시까지 이 대통령의 페이스북에 기재된 링크를 통해 할 수 있다.)

Regarding the citizen observation group system, the Blue House explained in a press release, “It is a citizen-participatory work report format where the sovereign people directly receive the work report and ask questions about points of curiosity,” adding, “Through this, we plan to faithfully implement the philosophy of a people’s sovereignty government that approaches administration from the perspective of policy consumers.” (청와대는 국민참관단 제도와 관련해 “주권자인 국민이 직접 업무보고를 받고, 궁금한 점을 묻는 국민참여형 업무보고 방식”이라며 “이를 통해 정책 수요자의 눈에서 행정에 임하는 국민주권정부의 철학을 충실히 구현할 계획”이라고 보도자료를 통해 설명했다.)

This second work report has been organized to check whether the contents reported by each ministry during the ministerial work report conducted at the end of last year are being properly implemented, and to inform the public about policy achievements felt in daily life and future plans. Targets include the Office for Government Policy Coordination, 19 ministries, 6 offices, 18 agencies, 7 committees, and 140 public institutions promoting citizen-facing livelihood projects. The Blue House stated, “Reform tasks including structural reforms, locally led growth tasks, and national normalization tasks will also be covered in detail.” The entire work report process will be broadcast live via KTV. (이번 2차 업무보고는 지난 연말 실시했던 부처 업무보고 당시 각 부처가 보고한 내용이 제대로 이행되고 있는지 점검하고, 민생 체감 정책 성과와 향후 계획을 국민에 알리기 위해 마련됐다. 국무조정실과 19부·6처·18청·7위원회, 국민 체감형 민생사업을 추진하는 140개 공공기관이 대상이다. 청와대는 “구조개혁을 포함한 개혁과제, 지방주도 성장 과제, 국가 정상화 과제들에 대한 추진 상황도 상세히 다뤄질 예정”이라고 했다. 업무보고 전 과정은 케이티브이(KTV)를 통해 생중계된다.)

Reporter Ko Kyung-joo goh@hani.co.kr (고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Min-seok, former Prime Minister: “Does Jeong Cheong-rae really need to be party leader twice?” (총리 물러난 김민석 “정청래, 당 대표 굳이 두 번 할 필요 있나”)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok, the former prime minister who has now fully entered the race for the Democratic Party of Korea’s August 17 national convention after stepping down as prime minister, said of former leader Jeong Cheong-rae: “It’s hard to see the need or necessity for doing (the party leadership) twice in the same way he has done so far.” (국무총리직을 마치고 더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회에 본격 나서게 된 김민석 전 총리가 정청래 전 대표를 향해 “지금까지 했던 방식으로 굳이 (당 대표를) 두 번 할 필요나 필연성을 발견하기 어렵다”고 말했다.)

In an interview with OhmyTV released on the 1st, conducted the previous day, Kim stated: “Former leader Jeong has worked hard and achieved things, but now the overall tasks and challenges need to be realized through a different leadership. It’s time for a leader with a slightly different color, capability, style, and strengths than former leader Jeong.” He added, “Especially now that the government needs to carry out tasks (policies) centered around President Lee Jae-myung, a solid foundation and support from the party are necessary. However, election results are actually dragging down (approval ratings), and the scope of the party’s role and the magnitude of challenges have widened and grown. It’s time for the party to move more decisively.” <<> Kim also commented on author Yoo Si-min’s ‘reconstruction theory,’ saying, “There are many parts I disagree with. It seems some facts don’t align, and the president striving to be the ‘president for everyone’ is not excessive confidence but a natural duty.” He added, “(Previously) as prime minister, it was difficult to speak about issues involving the business community, the president, or politics overall, but now, in a free position, I will address them all one by one.” <<> Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (김 전 총리는 1일 공개된 ‘오마이티브이(TV)’와 전날 한 인터뷰에서 “정 전 대표가 애쓰셨고 이루신 것도 있지만, 이제는 전체적인 과제와 숙제가 다른 리더십으로 실현돼야 할 때가 됐고, 정 전 대표보다는 좀 다른 색깔과 역량, 스타일, 장점을 가진 리더십이 필요한 때”라며 이렇게 말했다. 그러면서 “특히 지금 시기는 이재명 대통령을 중심으로 정부가 과제(정책)을 해야 하니까 (당의) 단단한 기반과 뒷받침이 필요하다”며 “그런데 선거 결과가 오히려 (지지율을) 끌어내리는 상황이고, 당 역할의 폭과 숙제의 크기가 더 넓고 커졌다. 당이 더 본격적으로 움직일 때”라고 말했다.)

item.title: Kim Jong-un sends congratulatory message to Xi Jinping for 'Chinese Communist Party Founding Day'..."Pyongyang meeting is a historic occasion" (김정은, ‘중국공산당 창건일’ 시진핑에 축전…“평양 상봉은 역사적 계기”)
item.description:
North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong-un sent a congratulatory message to Chinese President Xi Jinping on the 105th anniversary of the founding of the Chinese Communist Party, reaffirming his commitment to developing North Korea-China friendly relations. In particular, he emphasized President Xi's visit to Pyongyang last month as a "historic occasion." (김정은 북한 국무위원장이 중국공산당 창건 105돌을 맞아 시진핑 중국 국가주석에게 축전을 보내 북-중 친선 관계 발전 의지를 재확인했다. 특히 시 주석의 지난달 평양 방문을 “역사적 계기”라고 강조했다.)

In the message, Chairman Kim stated, "We are willing to continue to elevate and develop the DPRK-China friendly cooperative relations, a common asset of the peoples of both countries, in line with the demands of the times," according to the Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) on the 1st. Celebrating the anniversary of the Chinese Communist Party's founding, Kim praised the status and role of the Chinese Communist Party, saying, "Without the Communist Party, there would be no new China—this is a truth the Chinese people have learned while following the Party over a long period." He added, "It is our Party and government's unwavering stance to continuously strengthen and develop DPRK-China friendly relations, which are rooted in a long history and centered on socialism." (김 위원장은 축전에서 “두 나라 인민들의 공동의 재부인 조-중(북-중) 친선협조 관계를 시대적 요구에 맞게 계속 승화 발전시켜나갈 용의가 있다”고 밝혔다고 조선중앙통신이 1일 보도했다. 김 위원장은 중국공산당 창건 기념일을 축하하면서 “공산당이 없으면 새 중국도 없다는 것은 중국 인민이 장구한 기간 당을 따라 전진하여오면서 체득한 진리”라며 중국 공산당의 위상과 역할을 추켜세웠다. 그러면서 “오랜 역사적 뿌리를 가지고 있고 사회주의를 핵으로 하는 조-중 친선관계를 끊임없이 강화·발전시켜나가는 것은 우리 당과 정부의 확고부동한 입장”이라고 밝혔다.)

Recalling President Xi's visit to Pyongyang on the 8th and 9th of last month and the North Korea-China summit, Kim emphasized, "The Pyongyang meeting was a historic occasion that deepened our comradely friendship and trust and reaffirmed our unwavering will to more vigorously drive forward socialist construction and traditional friendly relations in both countries." He further noted, "The absolute superiority of DPRK-China relations is firmly guaranteed by the Party's leadership." (그는 지난달 8~9일 시 주석의 평양 방문과 북-중 정상회담을 상기하며 “평양 상봉은 우리들 사이의 동지적 우의와 신뢰를 두터이 하고 두 나라에서의 사회주의 건설과 전통적인 친선관계를 보다 힘있게 견인해 나가려는 드팀없는 의지를 다시금 확인한 역사적인 계기”였다고 강조했다. 이어 “조-중 관계의 절대적 우세는 당의 영도에 의해 굳건히 담보되고 있다”고 덧붙였다.)

Meanwhile, at the Chinese Embassy in North Korea on the 30th of last month, a banquet commemorating the 105th anniversary of the Chinese Communist Party's founding was hosted by Chinese Ambassador to North Korea Wang Yajun, inviting North Korean Workers' Party secretaries Jo Yong-won and Kim Song-nam. In his speech, Ambassador Wang stated, "Generations sharing fate, helping and protecting each other, and uniting with sincerity are the basic flow of China-DPRK friendly exchanges," and expressed "willingness to strengthen strategic communication and deepen the exchange of experiences in Party and state management." Prior to the banquet, the embassy also held a "DPRK-China Party Building Experience Exchange Symposium" between the Workers' Party and the Communist Party. (한편 주북 중국대사관에서는 지난달 30일 왕야쥔 주북 중국 대사가 주최하는 중국공산당 창건 105돌 기념 연회가 열려 북측에서 조용원·김성남 노동당 비서가 초대됐다. 왕 대사는 연설에서 “세대를 이어 운명을 함께하며 서로 도와주고 지켜주며 진심으로 단결하는 것은 중-조 친선교류의 기본 흐름”이라며 “전략적 의사소통을 강화하고 당 및 국가관리에서의 경험 교류를 심화할 용의가 있다”고 밝혔다. 연회에 앞서 대사관에서는 노동당과 공산당 간 ‘조-중 당건설 경험 교류 좌담회’도 진행됐다.)

With President Xi's visit to North Korea—the first in seven years since 2019—as a catalyst, North Korea and China agreed through a summit and joint statement to reaffirm their commitment to strengthening strategic communication and expanding cooperation, and to expand exchanges and cooperation in various fields such as economy, trade, military, agriculture, and construction, as well as high-level exchanges. Chairman Kim has been actively showcasing the recently strengthened bilateral relations, such as sending a congratulatory message and a wreath for President Xi's birthday last month. (북한과 중국은 2019년 이후 7년 만에 이뤄진 시 주석 방북을 계기로 정상회담과 공동성명을 통해 전략적 소통 강화와 협력 확대 의지를 재확인하고, 경제·무역과 군, 농업, 건설 등 다양한 분야에서의 교류 협력 및 고위급 교류를 확대하기로 했다. 김 위원장은 지난달에도 시 주석 생일을 맞아 축전과 화환을 보내는 등 최근 긴밀해진 양국 관계를 적극적으로 과시하고 있다.)

Park Min-hee, Senior Reporter minggu@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Park Jie-won: "DJ dismantled the Donggyodong faction for Roh Moo-hyun... Hope this lunch untangles the knot" (박지원 “DJ, 노무현 위해 동교동계 해체…엉킨 실타래 푸는 오찬 되길”)
item.description:
As President Lee Jae-myung and former President Moon Jae-in hold a luncheon meeting at the Blue House on the 1st, Democratic Party lawmaker Park Jie-won shared a past anecdote about former President Kim Dae-jung and expressed anticipation. <<> On the 30th, Rep. Park wrote on Facebook, "After former President Roh Moo-hyun's national funeral, DJ (Kim Dae-jung) called Moon Jae-in, Lee Hae-chan, and Park Jie-won to a Japanese restaurant at Seogyo Hotel," and relayed what Kim had said at that meeting. <<> "Now, we only have the Democratic Party—where is the Donggyodong faction, where is the Pro-Roh faction? It was because we failed to recreate power that President Roh Moo-hyun passed away. So, unite, consolidate, and recreate power." <<> Rep. Park also recalled a remark made by former President Kim at the end of 2002, when President Roh had just been elected, during a year-end stay at Cheongnamdae in Chungcheongbuk-do. <<> "The Donggyodong faction is the biggest contributor to my election as president. Now that my term is over, I think it is my duty and that of the Donggyodong faction to rally support for the new President Roh Moo-hyun. What does the chief of staff think?" <<> Rep. Park said, "(To this I replied,) 'There can only be one president, so you, former President, must make way for President Roh Moo-hyun.'"
